controls.statement: A human must approve each proposed action before the AI system executes it.
An assigned human operator can stop an AI-system action before execution completes.

documents.title: Invoice approval policy
documents.content:
# Invoice approval policy

## Release

A finance clerk must accept each payment proposal before the Invoice assistant submits it to the payment gateway. Rejected proposals are discarded.

## Operating reference

The operating sequence is described in [Gateway execution](evidence:invoice-operations@1#Invoice%20operations%20%2F%20Gateway%20execution).

documents.title: Invoice operations
documents.content:
# Invoice operations

## Gateway execution

The Invoice assistant sends every proposal to the payment gateway as soon as it is generated. No clerk acceptance is required in this deployment.

## Stop control

The duty operator can cancel a queued payment before submission. Once submission starts, the console cannot stop it; the operator can only record an incident.

documents.title: Invoice communications
documents.content:
# Invoice communications

## Editorial approval

A human editor approves the spelling of product newsletters before publication. This review does not cover payment proposals.

## Output

The Invoice assistant groups synthetic invoices by due date and generates payment proposals. This overview does not describe how a proposal is released or interrupted.

documents.title: Course assignment procedure
documents.content:
# Course assignment procedure

## Dispatch

Every course-assignment proposal stays in a waiting tray until a tutor countersigns that proposal. Only then does the Course advisor transmit the assignment.

## Human intervention

The assigned tutor has a stop control that halts transmission of an assignment while transmission is in progress.

documents.title: Course advisor operations
documents.content:
# Course advisor operations

## Release mode

The Course advisor transmits assignments automatically after generation. Tutors inspect a daily sample after transmission; they do not approve assignments beforehand.

## Exception handling

Tutors can intervene when necessary. This instruction does not specify whether intervention can stop a transmission or only change a later assignment.

documents.title: Course reporting guide
documents.content:
# Course reporting guide

## Report review

A coordinator approves the layout of a weekly course report. The layout review does not examine or authorize individual course assignments.

## Records

Assignment identifiers and generated times appear in the synthetic activity log. This section provides no information about prior approval or interruption controls.
